spec: kappa_sr_region_g; pooled-model benchmark under the primary intervention (change only the decision rule)
units: wins per team-season (sum of WP increments; 161.7 games per team); challenges per team-game
estimand: league-average accounting gap per team-season between the pooled-model benchmark and the teams' behaviour, a season of games like 2026, each team deviating alone

exit_rule.rule: switch to TAS if the 95 % CI of wins lost reaches 0.25 or is wider than 1.5

policies.label: Clairvoyant comparator (knows its future (p, g); not a bound)

co_primary.method: parametric bootstrap of the hyperparameters on game resamples with cross-fitted stakes, player effects re-estimated (EB) and drawn jointly

edge_test.note: slope of (Y - batting-team WP after a strike) on 1{ball} g; 1 = contrast right

slopes.note: logit scale: logit(1 - p*) on log g (postseason.implied_slope / opt_slope.py); controls full = challenges left, inning, two strikes, three balls; no_count = without the two count indicators; none = log g only. Ranges: high = log g > -5 (top ~60 % of eligible pitches), low = log g <= -5. kappa scale (belief-map free): d kappa / d log g of the fitted criterion averaged over the eligible pitches, and OLS of kappa on log g; s_opt: signal threshold (in) at which the calibrated belief reaches the optimum's p* = D/(g + D)

decomp.form_note: rule s > kappa(x) + a_side + (f_side - 1) * stake_c(x) [scale] or kappa(x) + a_side - stake_c(x) + b_side * (log g - mean) [linear]; stake_c = beta_logg log g + hinges kg, centred within side over opportunities; kappa(x) at the challenges the simulated team holds (sim.kappa_by_count)
